messages:
maya: Cross-cloud GPU shift for APAC starts tomorrow 06:00 UTC. I'm owner for the handoff window. I'll hand vendor contacts, quota numbers, and fallback plan here.

jon: heard — can you paste current quota numbers for apac and eu fallback? we need to update the PR.

maya: apac quotas: GCE A100: 28 GPUs, H100: 6 GPUs. reserved ephemeral pool: `ephemeral-demo-apac` = 4 A100. eu fallback pool: `eu-w1-fallback` = 8 A100.

maya: quick snippet to check quotas if you need:
```
gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast1 --format='json(quotas)'
# or
gcloud compute quota describe --region=asia-southeast1
```

liam: @maya sent terraform PR to bump quota and add pool — https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/812 — needs an approver for the billing tag + cost center.

nisha: can we hold the 4 A100 for the customer demo on Thursday? cost center is `demo-q3`.

maya: yes locked as ephemeral-demo-apac for Thurs 09:00-12:00 UTC. putting a note in the PR.

vendor-bot: Vendor update: APAC rack delivery ETA ~ 36 hours. Firmware validation pending, will confirm once racks are on-site. Contact: apac-ops@vendorco.example.com

jon: thanks @vendor-bot. if firmware delays, fallback to eu region ok? any perf implications we should call out?

maya: eu fallback latency + memory-to-host differences — expect ~10-20ms added p95 and same perf for throughput. quant profile similar. I'll add a canary job to smoke the model on eu-fallback at 05:30 UTC tomorrow.

liam: quick FYI — can the canary use `model:llama-13b-q3` or should we switch to `llama-13b-quant` for memory headroom?

maya: use `llama-13b-quant` for canary. If canary passes, automatic routing will switch per our rollout policy.

jon: reviewing the PR now. ping @liam for final approve. :eyes:

liam: ack, I'll review in 30m.

oncall-bot: Scheduled handoff: APAC GPU shift — starts 2026-03-19 06:00 UTC — pager on for 12 hours. Link: https://oncall.redwood.example/shift/142

nisha: thanks all — re cost center, will file chargeback if we exceed allocated demo quota. :+1:

maya: done — added note to PR about cost center and demo reservation. I'll post a short runbook in #eng-infra-docs after the canary.

jon: perfect. leaving this thread open for any last minute updates.

nisha: thanks, cya in handoff.
